# stripe_metronome_customer_alert (Resource)

A customer-scoped Metronome alert created by this resource. Import is unavailable because the alert GET response does not identify whether an alert is customer-scoped or account-wide. Destroy archives it. Advanced filters remain available through the generated create-alert action.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `alert_type` (String) CreateCustomerAlertPayload.alert_type from pinned OpenAPI.
- `customer_id` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `threshold` (Number)

### Optional

- `billable_metric_id` (String) For usage threshold alerts. The alert GET response omits this field, so Terraform retains the configured value. Changes replace the alert.
- `credit_type_id` (String)
- `deletion_protection` (Boolean) Set false and apply before archiving this alert.
- `evaluate_on_create` (Boolean) Whether to evaluate the alert immediately against existing usage. Defaults to false.
- `uniqueness_key` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `status` (String)
